description: Election Commission - Mr. D. G. J. R. Pushpakumara of the Seethawakapura Urban Council has vacated his office
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Seethawakapura Urban Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a direct matter related to the composition of a local elected body under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for content related to electoral processes, candidate registrations, and declarations about holding office.
